name: Shaida underwriting bot (demo)
description: Decides APPROVE, DECLINE or INCONCLUSIVE on a Shaida income proof link under a fixed, versioned policy. Deterministic rules, no LLM. It runs the full proof verification (strict schema, context opening, reader, expiry, ShaidaLedger.isKnownRoot at a pinned block, Groth16 with the ceremony's final key, dates from ledger events) and only then the policy rules in a fixed order.
determinism: The same link and the same policy (id, version, hash) give the same decisionId and decision while no time limit (expiry, proof age, days left) is crossed. INCONCLUSIVE is never an approval and is not cached: ask again.
sees: Only what is in the link: up to 8 Groth16 proofs with their 7 public signals (ledger root, asset, threshold, count, leaf range, context) and the context opening (reader id hash, expiry, salt). No payer, no amount per payment, no address, no note secret. The bot logs decision and proof ids and codes, never the link; it stores a hash of each proof it records on chain, and the rate limit keeps request times per IP for two minutes.
readerBinding: A link must be made out to the policy's readerName. A name binds intent, not identity: anyone holding the link can submit it (LIMITS.md).

endpoints.description: Presets, recording switch, caps and the bot's address.

rateLimit.window: sliding 60 s, counted before the body is read

link.description: the proof link (https://…/v#…) or its fragment

record.description: also record an APPROVE on chain with IncomeVerifier.attest from the bot's key

threshold.description: tUSD8 base units (6 decimals): the link proves at least this much

rootTime.description: block time of the ledger leaf that formed the proof's root

record.description: null unless record was true: {ok, repeated, records} or {ok:false, error, records}

decline.means: The link does not prove what it says: it is malformed, edited, or not a Shaida proof.
The proof is not about tUSD8.
The link joins proofs made for different readers or expiry dates.
The link joins proofs built against different ledger states.
Two proofs in the link cover the same ledger leaves, so a payment could count twice.
The link's reader, expiry or salt do not match its proofs: it was altered.
The link was made for another reader, not for this bot.
The proof shows less income than this policy needs.
The proof counts fewer payments than this policy needs.
The proof covers fewer days of the ledger than this policy needs.
The proof spreads its total over more days than this policy allows, so the income per period could be lower.
The ledger state the proof was built on is older than this policy allows.
The link expires sooner than this policy needs.

inconclusive.means: try again shortly; nothing was decided or sent
